description: GEOX Biostratigraphy MCP Tool Manifest. Declares 4 tools for MCP agent discovery and capability negotiation per Model Context Protocol spec.

geox_biostrat_parse.name: geox_biostrat_parse
geox_biostrat_parse.description: Extract biozones, GDE events, and lithology from free biostratigraphic text. Multi-zone extraction with evidence tags. Returns biozones[], gde_events[], lithology_class, unparsed_terms[], warnings[].

geox_biostrat_nn_age.name: geox_biostrat_nn_age
geox_biostrat_nn_age.description: Convert NN biozone to age bracket with explicit calibration metadata. Returns zone, scheme (Martini 1971), age_top_ma, age_base_ma, epoch, calibration, and mandatory not_a_radiometric_age=true warning.

geox_biostrat_ruling_check.name: geox_biostrat_ruling_check
geox_biostrat_ruling_check.description: Detect contradictions in biostratigraphic interpretations. Tests facies compatibility, reworking/caving, and multi-discipline convergence. Returns PASS | WEAK_PASS | CONTRADICTION | HOLD | REJECT with required_next_evidence.

geox_biostrat_falsify.name: geox_biostrat_falsify
geox_biostrat_falsify.description: 8-gate Popperian falsification engine. G1-Facies G2-StratOrder G3-Taxonomy G4-Reworking G5-Diachroneity G6-Seismic G7-Sequence G8-Tectonic. Any single FALSIFIED → overall FALSIFIED. Science advances by eliminating what CANNOT be true.

governance.popper_rule: Any single FALSIFIED gate → overall FALSIFIED regardless of other passes

constitutional_alignment.F2_TRUTH: Every tool output carries evidence tags, source spans, and calibration provenance
constitutional_alignment.F4_CLARITY: Tool inputs and outputs are structured arrays, not collapsed prose
constitutional_alignment.F7_HUMILITY: Confidence hard-capped at 0.85 for biostratigraphic claims
constitutional_alignment.F11_AUDIT: Every tool call produces a receipt with verdict, risk, and human_review_required
